found.quote: Research Assistant on OneSearch allows you to search the library’s resources using this AI tool which allows you to search using natural language as a starting point to your research.

The Use of Generative AI Tools Declaration Form can be attached to your assignment to show when you have used a generative AI tool. You should include the details of the AI tool used, how you have used it and your search prompts.
The Library team has produced a Referencing Generative AI (GenAI) sources in your work guide, which highlights how to reference using the referencing styles in use across the University.
The material used by these tools has been scrapped from the internet this therefore contains bias, misrepresentation and marginalization of some groups.
